complete_instrument: First the full Gauss test and absorbing seed failure; then all endpoint/flux profiles and their full complement, or one chosen endpoint X/Y four-effect instrument with its full Gauss complement. Square-root Kraus operators specify the pointer work.

declared_source.Hamiltonian: Inherited number/electric/Casimir idle action plus the gauge-covariant nearest-neighbour native uc,dc electron bilinears with coefficient+1/8 and their adjoints; no endpoint hopping across the fixed reference boundary.
declared_source.hopping_coefficient_role: Declared common architecture coefficient, independent of particle trajectories or masses.
declared_source.links: Full L2(SU3 x U1) on every open-chain edge; no electric or representation cutoff.
declared_source.matter: Full thirty-CAR source at each vertex and the full native quantum reference at vertex0.
declared_source.self_adjointness: The finite-graph hopping is bounded by12*kappa*(L-1); bounded perturbation of the positive rotor/number Hamiltonian gives a self-adjoint lower-bounded full source.
